title: An exact original-Hamiltonian bridge replaces a phase-transfer assumption
statement: At alpha=1/2 the physical classical exchange form obeys E_cl(a)+sum_i|a_i|^2=(1/4)sum_plaquettes|sum_i_in_p a_i|^2>=0, equivalently Fourier exchange eigenvalue>=-2. For a physical block product, real cross-block means and intra-block quantum covariances give energy>=sum_B F_B, where F_B(rho)=Tr H_B rho-sum_ij A_ij a_i dot a_j and A=I+J/2 is PSD. F_B is concave, so pure-state minima suffice. W_B=(H_B^(1)+H_B^(2))/2-sum_ij A_ij S_i^(1) dot S_j^(2) equals F_B on psi tensor psi; W_B>=-gamma|B|I therefore bounds all block density matrices. Disconnected physical supports reduce by component additivity even when the block entangles components. The bilayer identity uses relative spins; its enlarged eigenvectors may be unphysical copy correlations, so the relaxation gives only a sufficient bound, not a physical ground state or global-marginal solver. At gamma91/200 every block<=5 yields the stated five-producible energy floor-.455 on the original lattice, with no gap or susceptibility premise.

requires: J1>0; original square-lattice NN J1 and NNN alpha J1 exchange, S=sigma/2. Main five-producible result at alpha=1/2 on compatible periodic tori, L divisible by4 and L>=12; thermodynamic preparation/mixture-limit scope as stated.

k-producible means convex mixtures of products of blocks of at most k physical spins, allowing nongeometric blocks and different partitions. Stronger consequences require the reported old physical trial upper<-0.46909; underlying old source unavailable.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Two-copy spaces grow as4^k and lattice motifs combinatorially. Reported exact checks:22 weighted motifs at k<=4, all Sz sectors up to70;45 five-site motifs,252-dimensional Sz0 blocks,3.1MB Gram factors and signed64 overflow guards. Constructor floating Cholesky is distinct from integer verification.

Physical cooling, state preparation and measurement were not performed. IID bond/axis measurement contract needs about1,080,864 independently prepared samples for the displayed99%/half-margin target, before calibration, drift and readout costs.
contract.units: Energy per physical spin in units J1; kBT/J1 dimensionless; trace distance uses full norm, not half. Temperature bounds sufficient,not critical. Replica spins are a certificate representation,not a replacement physical Hamiltonian.
